svg.aria-label: S1 One integer scheduler queue, entry by entry
svg.text: S1 One integer scheduler queue, entry by entry
A template that the Passages player fills in. It shows one of the six integer queues, and select issues its oldest ready entry.
, q1 to q6. The player names which one.
Probes see a pair of queues as one and count double.
Empty rows mean nothing else is in flight.
Each unit broadcasts one result tag a cycle.
A matching tag marks a source ready.
Two ready sources make the entry ready.
How select finds the oldest ready
1. A set cell in row i, column j means
entry i is older than entry j.
2. A new entry sets its column in every
3. The oldest ready entry has a clear
4. An entry that issues clears its row.
~ Apple's patent and Handley describe it
It issues one entry per cycle.
When idle, it issues its partner's second choice.
Units u1 to u6 each have a queue of their own.
A shifted ALU op issues twice.
to the register file and the bypass
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
